spec: Implement the user-supplied requirements at https://github.com/contoso/travel-concierge/issues/38. Source revision: 2026-10-12T08:45:00Z. Task acceptance criteria below map that scope to specialist-owned work.

tasks.title: Restructure the concierge as a policy and booking workflow
tasks.body:
Build an Agent Framework workflow in `src/concierge` with stable `policy` and `booking` executors, keep the trip draft in the workflow state and serve it from `main.py` through a zero-argument factory.

## Acceptance criteria
- A conversation resumed after a host restart keeps the trip draft and any pending approval.
- Existing policy and booking tests pass unchanged against the workflow.

tasks.title: Search flight and hotel offers per leg
tasks.body:
Add a read-only `search_offers` tool that queries the booking API for one leg and returns offers fenced as data; no approval is needed because nothing is reserved.

## Acceptance criteria
- Offers for each leg are shown with the policy result for the whole trip.
- Tests mock the booking API, including an offer whose text contains an instruction.

tasks.title: Evaluate multi-turn trip planning
tasks.body:
Add synthetic multi-turn conversations for multi-city trips to `evals/`, scored for task adherence on the final turn.

## Acceptance criteria
- The dataset covers a trip resumed after a restart and a leg that breaks policy.
- Results are reported against `evals/thresholds.json`.

tasks.title: Trace the workflow steps
tasks.body:
Add OpenTelemetry spans for the workflow executors and tools, exported to Application Insights through `APPLICATIONINSIGHTS_CONNECTION_STRING`.

## Acceptance criteria
- A multi-turn conversation shows one trace per turn with the executor and tool spans.
- Traces contain no traveller names or booking references.
